title: Figma 的資料管道升級記——從 6 小時 cron 到分鐘級 CDC 的三年路
summary: Figma 把資料管道從每日 cron 全表 dump 改成 PostgreSQL CDC + Kafka + Snowflake 增量合併，延遲從 30+ 小時降到 3 小時，並補上每週 cell-by-cell re-bootstrap 審計。
widget_questions: At each year (2020 → 2023 → 2024 → 2025 → 2026), what was Figma's data-flow shape, and where was the cost concentrated?
Across operational dimensions (latency, cost, scale, audit, primary-load, incident-rate), what is the magnitude of the old-to-new delta?
Across six years of evolution, how did per-table sync latency collapse from 30+ hours toward minutes, and when did the typical-table and largest-table curves converge?
Which component in the 2026 CDC architecture owns the bootstrap offset-overlap invariant, and which owns the cell-by-cell audit?
